name: Anima LoRA image-style generalization
prompt: Preserve the content of the first reference image and transfer the artistic style of the second reference image.

checkpoint_roles.lora10135: adapter in joint dynamic checkpoint; hooks disabled
checkpoint_roles.original_cnn10135: same adapter with original CNN900 and dynamic residual off
checkpoint_roles.dynamic_cnn10135: same adapter with original CNN900 and dynamic residual on
checkpoint_roles.base_no_lora: all existing LoRA weights zero, no CNN, native B/A route remains

limits: Pretrained base and early training exposure for external images or style labels is not established.
Original plan val styles are held out by that plan, but not proven unseen across all historical runs.
Paired C is a dataset-provided stylized target, not the unique ground truth for arbitrary style transfer.
Metrics are proxies; no automatic disentanglement percentage, no identity/quality guarantee.
This fixed 9-content external grid is not a population-representative sample.
For paired/branch-control suites only the first seed is used; external grid uses two seeds.

inference.input_preprocessing: EXIF transpose; RGB; PIL BICUBIC resize to 1024x1024 without preserving aspect ratio
inference.precision: base/VAE native bfloat16; LoRA masters float32 and cast for forward
inference.lora_scale: native forward y + up(down(x)); no separate alpha multiplier
inference.checkpoint_note: The joint run froze adapter weights while training CNN; later 10788 and joint 10135 have different recorded histories, so no claim of a 653-step paired continuation.

analysis_plan.style: Report per-reference and per-content style similarity using available validated metrics; descriptive proxy, not style accuracy.
analysis_plan.content: Report per-content structural/perceptual proxy plus visual identity, object and layout changes; no interpretation as identity verification.
analysis_plan.texture: Inspect full-resolution zoomed crops for medium-specific edges and marks; no universal numerical percent claimed.
analysis_plan.reference_content_leak: Matched same-B/different-A comparisons and visual evidence, reporting concrete cases rather than inferred absolute purity.
analysis_plan.aggregates: Report per-content and per-style groups; two seeds and repeated references sharing B/C are dependent, not independent images. If confidence intervals are estimated, use grouped resampling and disclose n.
analysis_plan.human_review: QA visual review is an inspection; no fabricated blinded multi-rater human study.
analysis_plan.comparisons: Same condition and seed: lora10135 vs lora10788; 10135 vs old/dynamic residual; native B/A route no-LoRA control. No SOTA claim without external baselines.
